description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASETuesday, January 20, 2026 PHOENIX, ARIZONA— A long-running effort to end the use of photo radar in Arizona is moving forward today as the Senate Appropriations, Transportation, & Technology Committee hears SCR 1004, sponsored by Senator Wendy Rogers. SCR 1004 takes a direct and transparent approach: it refers the question of banning photo radar
title: Letting Voters Decide: Senate Republicans Advance Ballot Measure to End Photo Radar in Arizona | Wendy Rogers
